methodology.desktop: Full-resolution website sections downloaded from Mobbin image_url; linked to canonical mobbin_url. Original capture dates are not supplied.
methodology.mobile: Original case study websites rendered in local Chrome at 390 × 1100 CSS pixels, mobile input enabled, device scale 1; captured 12 October 2026. Interior examples were scrolled to the relevant section. These are supplemental live captures, not screenshots from Mobbin’s iOS library.
methodology.unit: 20 distinct case studies, each represented by a desktop section and paired responsive mobile view. One Maze pairing compares an archived solution section with the current opening.
methodology.limits: Visual precedent research, not customer interviews or usability testing. Current live websites may differ from Mobbin’s archived desktop captures. Screenshots do not establish motion, accessibility, performance or conversion effectiveness.
